field_principles.arm_ebm_citation_rows: Separate rows keep the two anchor citation trails auditable.
field_principles.arxiv_release_boundary: A dated cutoff prevents old papers from being presented as a new milestone delta.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall time detects a receipt that skipped the requested source set.
field_principles.ebt_citation_rows: Paper-level rows prevent citation totals from hiding missing identifiers or irrelevant records.
field_principles.extropic_first_party_status: First-party product state may guide planning but cannot prove authenticated Carnot execution.
field_principles.field_principles: A principle map keeps each source field tied to its epistemic boundary.
field_principles.field_provenance: URLs, response hashes, and row IDs make every summary traceable.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: A blocked source must name the failed URL, expected response, observed response, and cached evidence.
field_principles.github_rows: Repository rows prevent popularity or recency from becoming an unexamined dependency decision.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The verdict must separate complete receipt, partial network block, and unsupported execution claim.
field_principles.huggingface_rows: Paper-page rows separate community promotion from primary experimental authority.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declaring primary_source_receipt_no_model_execution keeps document research separate from model inference.
field_principles.logical_intelligence_first_party_status: Kona claims remain product context until weights and a reproducible local runner exist.
field_principles.openreview_rows: Venue rows preserve review status and avoid treating submissions as established results.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: One source row per check makes novelty and disposition independently reviewable.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Network and cache checks prove the task knew which sources were reachable before drawing conclusions.
field_principles.promoted_findings: Explicit promotion reasons connect current work to bounded Carnot experiments.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Source ingestion must not rewrite protected evaluators or conductor logic.
field_principles.query_manifest: Exact queries make literature coverage reproducible and expose search blind spots.
field_principles.random_seed: A declared seed reproduces any deterministic result ordering or sampling.
field_principles.rendered_arc_leaderboard_receipt: A rendered receipt prevents public scores from being inferred from snippets or stale local files.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: The checksum binds query, cutoff, response hashes, and result.
field_principles.source_timestamps_and_hashes: Timestamps and hashes distinguish current primary pages from stale snippets or cached paraphrases.
field_principles.status: A complete source receipt is a valid terminal outcome even though sources are not execution oracles.
field_principles.tests_run: Executed checks distinguish verified receipt machinery from prose-only research.
field_principles.unavailable_substrates: Named missing credentials, weights, or devices stop source pages from becoming fabricated execution claims.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Source hashes verify page identity only; they do not verify product or model performance.
